description: This file defines a React functional component named SidebarRecommendations that renders a sidebar with recommended videos, including thumbnails and metadata. It includes helper functions to format view counts and publication dates.

methods.name: formatViews
methods.description: Formats a number of views into a human-readable string (e.g., 1.2K views, 3.4M views).

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Converts a publication date string into a locale-specific date string.
